description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.90.0 with dist-tag latest.
Bug Fixes
- Recover cold opaque state and harden replay, archive and lifecycle paths (#7388)
- Carry WS dispatch override, pooled key rotation, usage accounting and Kiro refusal hop (B3) (#7389)
- Renew pool credit evidence, recheck predicted-reset hard locks, and scope Direct fallback to the locked main (#7393)
- Carry Gemini, MiMo, DeepSeek, Mistral, opencode-go and audio adapter fixes for 2.90 (#7394)
- Harden OAuth login/import, quota diagnostics, service/update paths and shim token handling (B5) (#7397)
- Gate MiMo bare-call recovery on a terminal signal and limit DeepSeek upload roles (#7396)
- Carry Mistral rate-limit recovery and OpenGateway tool-result handling for 2.90 (#7395)
- Pin Windows shim refresh identities on Linux and record the bypass-token cold-spawn disposition (#7408)
- Stop pool accounts from spending the native main account (#7398) (#7414)
- Keep search replay ID allocation linear (#7419)
- Keep transpiler cache scopes within configured paths (#7422)
- Keep model text out of inferred cooldowns (#7424)
- Read the whoami identity when kiro-cli appends its Profile block (#7455)
- Preserve upgrade-only reasoning inclusion (#7464)
- Promote dev 845ac6b875 to main as 2.90.0 (#7474)
- Carry the dependency-audit fix to main for 2.90.0 (#7481)
Chores
- Bound shell integration scenarios independently (#7449)
Other Changes
- Open dev at 2.90.0 before releasing 2.89.0 (#7371)
